title: Sechelt language
description: Coast Salish language in British Columbia
extract: Sechelt is a Coast Salish language spoken by the Sechelt people of the shíshálh Nation in British Columbia. Originally spoken across the lands of the Sechelt people, the language today is nearly extinct; as of 2019 Margaret Joe Dixon was the last native speaker. Sechelt continues to be taught in local elementary schools and in higher education, including Capilano University.
